metadados.title: PRISM Scale - Pediatric Risk of Mortality
metadados.description: The PRISM (Pediatric Risk of Mortality) is a severity assessment scale used in pediatric intensive care units (PICU) to estimate the risk of mortality in hospitalized children.

Score Interpretation

Low Risk (0-5 points)
Reduced risk of mortality, organ failure absent or mild.

Moderate Risk (6-15 points)
Intermediate risk. Presence of dysfunctions requiring monitoring.

High Risk (16-20 points)
Multiple organ failure. Intensive intervention needed.

Very High Risk (> 20 points)
Extremely high risk of mortality. Severe and irreversible dysfunction.
